# AI Design Guide — P1 Resources / Anti-patterns

## Access

| Resource | Access | Kit status |
|----------|--------|------------|
| [AI Anti-Patterns Gallery](https://www.aidesign.guide/guides/ai-anti-patterns-gallery) | **Free account (login wall)** | Doctrine only until licensed export |
| [Resources](https://www.aidesign.guide/resources) | Mixed / often login | OG + public children |
| Public guides (agentic DS, workflows, trust levels) | **Public** | Captures in this folder |

## Doctrine mapping (anti-patterns → kit)

Even without gallery binaries, kit `.cursorrules` / `AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md` already ban the common clichés:

| Anti-pattern (guide) | Kit rule |
|----------------------|----------|
| Purple / indigo AI gradients | No purple marketing chrome |
| Soft SaaS empty cards / blobs | Dense Linear/Raycast; hairlines |
| Oversized sparkle / emoji UI | Status over decoration |
| Lone spinner for agent work | `streaming-thought-state` |
| Ungated irreversible tools | `mandate-approval-card` |

When you have a free-account session, drop Mobbin / guide crops into this folder as `anti-patterns__*.webp` and link from `disclosure` / host brand docs.

## Files

See `manifest.json`. Public guide hero / OG / figure shots live here; Agentic UX pattern product shots stay in parent `../`.
